hits.s: rs. 26 Hole 170m to 950m TVD BRT The 26 hole section lithology consists of sands and soft sticky clays which transition into the Nordland Group Tertiary shales at approximately 400m BRT. The Nordland shales are typically soft and gumbo producing. Problems that may be encountered include tight hole, gumbo, stuck pipe and balling of the bit. The section will be drilled riserless with 17 1/2 pilot hole first which is ch

on. Maintaining high annular flowrate to ensure good hole cleaning and to prevent packing off will be important. If the Petrofree proves unworkable and the hole is subsequently drilled with KC1 polymer, then there is liklihood of gumbo and cavings being experienced.
